words.definition: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day
words.example: The store closes for lunch break at noon.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家店在中午會休息用午餐。
words.note: 反義詞：midnight（午夜），別跟 noon 搞混

words.definition: a person whose job is to keep or check financial records
words.example: Our accountant will prepare the quarterly financial report.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們的會計師會準備這一季的財務報告。
words.note: 相關詞：accounting (n.) 會計這門業務/學科，accountant 則指從事會計工作的人

words.definition: a person who works in an office or store handling records or sales
words.example: The clerk at the front desk checked us in quickly.
words.exampleTranslation: 櫃檯的職員很快就幫我們辦好入住手續。
words.note: 英式發音近似 clark，美式則唸作 klurk，兩地發音明顯不同

words.definition: a large entrance hall in a hotel or office building
words.example: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at seven tomorrow morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們明天早上七點在飯店大廳見面吧。
words.note: lobby 也可作動詞，指「遊說」，例如 lobby for a new policy，是政治上常見用法

words.definition: to prepare and issue a book, magazine, or piece of writing for the public
words.example: The company plans to publish its annual report next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司計劃下個月發布年度報告。
words.note: 相關詞：publisher (n.) 出版商，publication (n.) 出版品

words.definition: a short document summarizing a person's work experience and education
words.example: Please attach your résumé and a cover letter to the application.
words.exampleTranslation: 請在申請表中附上你的履歷表和求職信。
words.note: 美式英語用 résumé，英式英語通常用 CV（curriculum vitae）表示履歷

words.definition: to put something inside an envelope or package along with a letter
words.example: I have enclosed a copy of the receipt for your records.
words.exampleTranslation: 我隨函附上收據的副本以供您留存。
words.note: 相關詞：enclosure (n.) 附件，商業書信常縮寫成 Enc.

words.definition: a person who formally applies for a job, loan, or position
words.example: Over two hundred applicants applied for the marketing position.
words.exampleTranslation: 超過兩百位應徵者申請了這個行銷職缺。
words.note: 動詞形：apply (v.) 申請，例如 apply for a position

words.definition: a meeting for discussion or training on a particular subject
words.example: She attended a seminar on effective time management.
words.exampleTranslation: 她參加了一場關於有效時間管理的研討會。
words.note: seminar 通常指講座、討論式的研討會，workshop 則較著重實作練習

words.definition: a person skilled in the practical or mechanical side of a job
words.example: A technician was sent to repair the printer this afternoon.
words.exampleTranslation: 今天下午派了一位技師來修理印表機。
words.note: 相關詞：technical (adj.) 技術性的，例如 technical support（技術支援）

words.definition: woven or knitted material used to make items such as clothing
words.example: The tablecloth is made from a durable, easy-to-clean cloth.
words.exampleTranslation: 這張桌巾是用耐用又容易清潔的布料做的。
words.note: cloth 是不可數名詞指「布料」本身，別跟恆為複數的 clothes（衣服）搞混

words.definition: the money charged for a trip on a bus, train, plane, or taxi
words.example: The train fare increases slightly during peak hours.
words.exampleTranslation: 尖峰時段的火車票價會稍微上漲。
words.note: fare 與 fair（公平的；博覽會）同音異義，書寫時勿混淆

words.definition: a printed statement confirming that money or goods were received
words.example: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the item.
words.exampleTranslation: 請保留收據，以防你需要退貨。
words.note: receipt 中的 p 不發音，唸作 /rɪˈsiːt/

words.definition: a person who is traveling or who travels often
words.example: Frequent travelers can earn points toward a free flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 常搭飛機的旅客可以累積點數換取免費機票。
words.note: 美式拼法為 traveler，英式拼法則雙寫 l 成 traveller

words.definition: a person who makes a phone call
words.example: The receptionist asked the caller to hold for a moment.
words.exampleTranslation: 接待員請來電者稍等一下。
words.note: 常見於 caller ID（來電顯示）這個複合詞

words.definition: an underground railway system in a city
words.example: It's faster to take the subway than to drive downtown.
words.exampleTranslation: 搭地鐵到市中心比開車快。
words.note: 美式英語稱地鐵為 subway，英式英語則常用 underground 或 tube

words.definition: bags and suitcases used to carry belongings while traveling
words.example: Please make sure your luggage is tagged with your name and address.
words.exampleTranslation: 請確認你的行李有貼上姓名和地址的標籤。
words.note: luggage 是不可數名詞沒有複數形，要說「一件行李」得用 a piece of luggage

words.definition: a batch of goods sent together to a destination
words.example: The next shipment of parts is expected to arrive on Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 下一批零件貨運預計星期五抵達。
words.note: 動詞形：ship (v.) 運送，例如 We will ship the order tomorrow

words.definition: to work out or conclude something from evidence rather than being told directly
words.example: From the report, we can infer that sales declined due to weak demand.
words.exampleTranslation: 從這份報告我們可以推斷出，銷售下滑是因為需求疲弱。
words.note: 常與 imply（暗示）搞混：infer 是聽者/讀者的推論，imply 才是說話者的暗示

words.definition: a man who serves food and drinks to customers in a restaurant
words.example: The waiter recommended the seafood pasta as today's special.
words.exampleTranslation: 服務生推薦今天的特餐海鮮義大利麵。
words.note: 陰性形 waitress（女服務生），現今也常用中性字 server 取代兩者
